title: WF03 stage11 sim05-08 testfix: integration startup contention at TC-DB-01-01 caused non-deterministic stall behavior
summary: Diagnosed integration stall as environment contention during harness startup (migration/reset path) and removed non-deterministic behavior by introducing DB session timeouts plus a focused SIM-05..SIM-08 integration target for deterministic verification.

root_cause.details: Overlapping or contended integration execution could block SQL statements at the first integration test (TC-DB-01-01: migrations), producing apparent hangs without deterministic timeout failure.

changes: Added connection-level lock/statement/idle-in-transaction timeouts in tests/integration/helpers.zig TestHarness initialization to fail fast under contention.
Added focused build target test-integration-sim05-08 in build.zig for deterministic SIM-05..SIM-08 verification.
Fixed unrelated zig build test blocker in tests/unit/db_test.zig by importing pool types through bpm module wiring.

commands.evidence: Completed successfully after db_test module import fix

commands.command: BPM_TEST_DB_URL=... BPM_TEST_URL=... BPM_IDP_BASE_URL=... zig build test-integration-sim05-08 --summary all
commands.evidence: Build Summary: 5/5 steps succeeded; 18/18 tests passed; SIM0508_INTEGRATION_EXIT_CODE=0
